items.title: GDDY Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in GoDaddy Inc. (NYSE: GDDY), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
items.summary: The Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against GoDaddy Inc. for allegedly issuing materially misleading business information to investors. The firm is preparing a class action lawsuit to recover investor losses and encourages affected shareholders to join the prospective class action.
